title: Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
abstract: arXiv:2611.26309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Textual recommendations generated by large language models (LLMs) can be difficult to inspect. This paper introduces \emph{Client Exits}, a lightweight mechanism for enriching LLM responses while separating semantic intent from client-specific presentation. The model inserts predefined, machine-interpretable markers into its output, and the receiving client decides whether and how to realize the corresponding enrichments. This allows supplementary information to be presented as graphics, text, speech, or other modalities without prescribing a concrete interface. We implement a prototype combining a finetuned Qwen model with a modified LibreChat client. Using the Question--Option--Criteria (QOC) approach including three XML-based client exits. translated_title: 客户端出口——一种在客户端提升大语言模型透明度的方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本推荐往往难以审查。本文提出了“客户端出口”，这是一种轻量级机制，用于丰富LLM的响应，同时将语义意图与客户端特定的呈现方式分离开来。模型在其输出中插入预定义的、机器可解释的标记，由接收端的客户端决定是否以及如何实现相应的丰富内容。这使得补充信息能够以图形、文本、语音或其他模态呈现，而无需规定具体的交互界面。我们实现了一个原型，将微调后的Qwen模型与修改后的LibreChat客户端相结合，采用问题-选项-标准（QOC）方法，包含三种基于XML的客户端出口。我们评估了两个面向QOC的模型变体，它们在基本相同的样本上训练，其中一个变体添加了客户端出口标注。在100个测试问题上，客户端出口模型包含……
tldr: 本文提出“客户端出口”机制，让LLM在输出中插入机器可解释的标记、由客户端自行决定如何以图形、文本、语音等多模态呈现补充信息，从而在不规定具体界面的情况下提升LLM响应的透明度与可审查性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Client Exits," a lightweight mechanism in which LLMs insert machine-interpretable markers into their outputs, allowing client applications to decide how to render supplementary information across modalities and thereby increasing transparency of LLM responses.
